paragraphs.text: Fire counters are a type of counter introduced in Avatar: The Last Airbender . They are used to represent the additional power firebenders gain when Sozin's Comet passes by the world.

Sozin's Comet is a celestial event of great importance to firebenders in Avatar: The Last Airbender because it dramatically increases their firebending abilities. When the comet passes close to the Earth, it enhances the power of the sun, which is the source of firebending. This enhancement allows firebenders to generate more intense and destructive flames.

Fire counters are used to represent this enhancement on Fated Firepower by increasing the damage dealt by sources controlled by the player with the enchantment. It is also used on War Balloon to permanently transform the Vehicle into an artifact creature .
